# A hawk (generated by make_env.py), origin at its body.
new
material new Feather --base-color 0.329 0.200 0.267 --no-slot
material new Belly --base-color 0.545 0.251 0.286 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Body --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 0.000
scale 0.180 0.600 0.140
apply --scale
material assign Belly
add mesh cube --name WingL --size 1 --location -0.400 0.020 0.060
scale 0.650 0.300 0.050
apply --scale
material assign Feather
set rotation 0 12 0
add mesh cube --name WingR --size 1 --location 0.400 0.020 0.060
scale 0.650 0.300 0.050
apply --scale
material assign Feather
set rotation 0 -12 0
add mesh cube --name Tail --size 1 --location 0.000 0.380 0.000
scale 0.240 0.200 0.040
apply --scale
material assign Feather
select all
shade flat
export bird.glb
